result.title: Learning Inter-Graph Interactions Between Heterogeneous Substructures of Chemical Systems
result.summary: Complex chemical systems containing heterogeneous substructures are common in real-world applications. Various physical phenomena of the complex chemical systems are derived from the interactions between the heterogeneous substructures. However, existing graph representation learning methods for inter-graph interactions assumed graph-level interactions between homogeneous structures, such as organic molecules and inorganic crystalline materials. We propose a data descriptor of the complex chemical systems and a graph neural network for learning inter-graph interactions between organic and inorganic compounds. We applied the proposed method to predict the physical properties of hybrid solar cell materials containing heterogeneous substructures, which have received significant attention for sustainable energy resources. By learning heterogeneous inter-graph interactions, the proposed method achieved state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting band gaps of 1,682 hybrid solar cell materials.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向含异质子结构的复杂化学系统的数据描述符与图神经网络，用于学习有机与无机化合物之间的图级相互作用，并预测混合太阳能电池材料的带隙，在 1,682 种材料上取得当前最佳精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式建模异质子结构间交互的表示方式，可能为 LVR 中不同实体或模态子结构之间关系如何编码与更新提供可核查线索；但该工作面向材料性质预测，不含推理过程或视觉证据，迁移价值需进一步判断。
